dependency_edges.handoff: Fleet counts and type allocation become annual electricity demand.
Off-peak residual C(t) becomes the energy-mix demand constraint.

Country generation mix supplies grid CO2 intensity.
Jobs and monetary output feed the four-impact conclusion.
CO2, oil, and country curves feed nitrogen/world synthesis and actor recommendations.
